blocks.orig: Mkomazi View Camp lies in a secluded valley called Watershed inside Mkomazi National Park, where it overlooks one of the biggest waterholes in the park. The camp lies close to the Mbula Rhino Sanctuary, where you can watch the endangered rhino at close range, and the Dindira Dam, a popular spot where many wild animals come to drink. The camp houses only eight ensuite tents, running on solar power and equipped with outside bucket showers. Its stunning location in combination with more than just a touch of comfort and privacy ensures a lovely evening under the endless night sky of Mkomazi.
blocks.html: Mkomazi View Camp is tucked away in a quiet valley known as Watershed in Mkomazi National Park, looking out over one of the park's largest waterholes. Nearby are the Mbula Rhino Sanctuary, where you can see the endangered rhino up close, and the Dindira Dam, a favourite spot where lots of wild animals come to drink. The camp has just eight ensuite tents, which run on solar power and have outdoor bucket showers. Thanks to its beautiful setting, together with a good measure of comfort and privacy, you can look forward to a lovely evening beneath Mkomazi's endless night sky.
